subject: Audit log handover: fields, retention and export scenarios
messages:
From: Maya Singh <audit-team@clearwellhealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: admin activity log fields + export options for SOC2 evidence

Hi Logan,

We're preparing the SOC 2 evidence bundle for Clearwell Health's audit and need to confirm what your admin activity capture covers and how we can get an export. Can you provide: 

- canonical list of event types/fields (timestamp, actor id, actor role, action, resource id, IP, session id, token changes, etc.)
- retention windows (hot vs archive) and any options for extended retention
- export delivery options (S3 presigned, SFTP, signed manifest, incremental snapshots)
- time zone normalization and any PII redaction/differential sampling you support

We prefer an S3 handoff but can accommodate signed SFTP. Also please attach any example manifests and a small sample CSV of the field set.

Thanks — if you can get the list and a short notes doc by EOD tomorrow that would be great.

— Maya
Audit Manager, Clearwell Health
[Attachment: vendor_intake_form.pdf (PDF)]

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Singh <audit-team@clearwellhealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: admin activity log fields + export options for SOC2 evidence

Maya — thanks for the clear list. High level summary below and I've attached a CSV of the canonical fields plus a manifest template for exports.

Short answer (TL;DR):
- Full admin activity ledger: sign-ins, console actions (create/update/delete), role/permission changes, API key/credential events, model deployments and rollback, configuration changes (networking, billing, region changes), vault/KMS operations (key create/rotate/access), and operator session metadata.
- Retention: default 365 days (hot searchable), cold archive snapshots retained 5 years by request (jurisdiction-dependent).
- Exports: daily incremental snapshots (parquet/JSONL) + one-off full snapshots via S3 presigned PUT or secure SFTP. We provide an HMAC-signed manifest and per-file SHA256 checksums.
- TZ normalization: exports are normalized to UTC and include original local tz offset per event.
- PII handling: we can pseudonymize actor identifiers (salted hash) and redact configurable fields for export.

What I'm attaching:
- admin_activity_fields.csv (canonical fields + types)
- export_manifest_template.json (HMAC fields, file size, checksums, time window)

Quick operational notes:
- Incremental snapshots are available on a 24h cadence; they include a monotonic sequence id to allow gap detection.
- For ad-hoc evidence requests we can generate a one-off export within 48 hours; emergencies (escalated via your security contact) are handled faster — see Ben's note below.

Can you confirm: preferred delivery (S3 or SFTP), target time window (UTC start/end), and whether you need actor identifiers pseudonymized? Once confirmed we'll schedule the snapshot and send a handshake (S3 bucket/prefix + IAM role or SFTP creds).

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: admin activity log fields + export options for SOC2 evidence

Maya — a couple of implementation clarifications from infra/security side: 

1) Timezone & timestamps: all stored events include an ISO8601 timestamp and the system/collector offset. Exports are normalized to UTC (Z) but include field source_tz_offset to show original offset if you need exact local time context.

2) PII / pseudonymization: when requested we salt+HMAC actor identifiers using a customer-specific salt. That salt is not exported. We also offer field-level redaction rules (e.g., redact email and IP) or hash them depending on your data retention policy.

3) Export mechanics:
   - Incremental snapshots: generated every 24 hours at 00:00 UTC for the previous day; filename pattern includes sequence id and time window.
   - Full snapshot: we can stream a full export (parquet/JSONL) to your S3 prefix via presigned PUT or transfer over our SFTP endpoint.
   - Verification: every export includes SHA256 checksums in the manifest and an HMAC over the manifest using a KMS-wrapped key. For higher assurance, we can sign the manifest and provide a signed attestation PDF (required for certain auditors).

4) Retention exceptions: default hot retention 365 days. If you need >365 days we can set an archive policy and maintain immutable snapshots for up to 5 years (jurisdiction permitting). A legal hold is possible but requires a written request and may affect storage billing.

5) Sampling & differential exports: we don't sample admin activity by default (that would weaken auditability), but for very large tenancy exports we can provide a certified sample set and an attestation describing sampling methodology.

Link to our SFTP handshake/runbook: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-admin-evidence-template

If that all sounds good we'll wait for the S3 prefix and target window and schedule the export.

— Kimberly
Director, Trust & Compliance, Redwood Inference

Thanks Logan / Kimberly — this is very helpful. A few follow-ups: 

- Can you confirm the manifest HMAC method and whether Clearwell will receive the public verification key or a KMS thumbprint?
- For the pseudonymization: we need actor->role mapping to be preserved (so we can prove admin vs non-admin), even if actor ids are hashed. Will the salted hashes be stable over the requested window?
- SLA: what is the guaranteed retrieval time for a one-off full export (we sometimes need same-day pulls during tight audit windows).

I've attached our intake form with the delivery preferences. Prefer S3 with an IAM role; target window first week of June 2026 (2026-06-01T00:00:00Z to 2026-06-07T23:59:59Z). Please confirm and we'll raise a PO if needed.

— Maya

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Singh <audit-team@clearwellhealth.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2026 15:58:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: admin activity log fields + export options for SOC2 evidence

Hi Maya — quick security confirmation and SLA notes from my side: 

- Manifest verification: we use HMAC-SHA256 over the manifest and provide per-file SHA256 checksums. For external verification we'll provide an X.509 certificate with the public key fingerprint (or KMS key id) depending on your verifier's requirements.
- Salted hashes: actor identifiers hashed with a customer salt are stable across exports for the same salt and key version. We will record the salt/key version in the manifest (salt not included) so you can demonstrate stability without exposing raw identifiers.
- SLA: standard one-off export turnaround is 48 hours after request is accepted. For audit-critical windows we offer an expedited 4-hour window with written escalation (security@clearwell to security@redwoodinference). Expedited requests may require a formal PO or signed addendum.

Next steps for us to schedule the job:
1) Confirm delivery: S3 (preferred) or SFTP and provide S3 bucket/prefix + IAM role ARN.
2) Confirm window: you provided 2026-06-01T00:00:00Z to 2026-06-07T23:59:59Z — we can do that.
3) Confirm pseudonymization: if you want stable salted hashes we will apply them. Confirm whether role mapping (admin/non-admin) should be kept in clear or as a role code.

Once we have that we'll kick off the export and send you a signed manifest + checksums.

— Ben Carter
Principal Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: export_manifest_template.json (JSON)]
